status.summary: Former two-time UFC women's bantamweight champion (won the belt from Amanda Nunes at UFC 269, Dec 11, 2021; lost it back at UFC 277, Jul 30, 2022; regained it from Raquel Pennington at UFC 307, Oct 5, 2024). She has not fought in MMA since losing the title to Kayla Harrison by kimura at 4:55 of R2 at UFC 316 (Jun 7, 2025). She said she went into that fight with a broken thumb and a torn elbow ligament; she had elbow surgery in July 2025 and later back surgery, and in Sep 2025 said she would not be back before 2026 and had not talked to the UFC about a return. No MMA bout is booked as of Nov 6, 2026. Her next competition is not MMA: a freestyle wrestling match against Diana Avsaragova at Real American Freestyle's Abu Dhabi card on Nov 14, 2026 (Etihad Arena); she has worked as an RAF commentator since Oct 2025. She is not retired and is still No. 1 at women's bantamweight in the UFC media-panel rankings. Pro MMA record 12-6 (Wikipedia, Sherdog). Age 37.
status.ranking: #1 women's bantamweight and #11 women's pound-for-pound (UFC media-panel rankings of Nov 3, 2026, as mirrored by UFCalendar and ufcrankings.org on Nov 5-6; ufc.com itself not fetched). UFC's algorithmic Meta rankings (updated Oct 31, 2026) have her #5 at bantamweight.
status.next_fight: Not MMA: freestyle wrestling match vs Diana Avsaragova (middleweight), RAF Abu Dhabi, Etihad Arena, Nov 14, 2026 (announced Oct 12, 2026; Sherdog, MMA Mania). No MMA bout booked (UFCalendar, Nov 6, 2026).

injuries.what: Broken thumb and a torn ligament in the elbow, both weeks before UFC 316; she fought Harrison with them (her account after the fight)

Back surgery and other surgeries mentioned on The Ariel Helwani Show (Sep 17, 2025); she said then she would not return before 2026. No later medical update found; she is booked to wrestle on Nov 14, 2026.

signature: rear-naked choke from the back: Sara McMann (R3, 2021) and Amanda Nunes (R2, UFC 269, title)
stands and trades at boxing range: out-landed Nunes 79-46 at UFC 269 (78 of her 79 at distance) before the finish
head-hunting volume: 248 of her 260 significant attempts vs Pennington went to the head
takedown and top control in the middle rounds: vs Pennington she landed 2 of 3 takedowns and held 5:20 of control in R2-R3
clinch work to the body: 25 of 30 clinch strikes and 22 of 27 body strikes vs Valentina Shevchenko (2017)
ground strikes from mount: TUF 18 final TKO of Jessica Rakoczy (2013) and elbows from mount vs Milana Dudieva (2015)
weaknesses: takedown defence: opponents complete 76% of their takedown attempts on her (career; division about 40%), and they average 309 s of control per 15 min (division 222)
submitted three times: armbar from guard (Shevchenko, 2017), guillotine (Germaine de Randamie, 2020), kimura from side control after 2 of 3 takedowns and 6:05 of control (Kayla Harrison, 2025)
knocked down four times: three by Nunes at UFC 277 and one by Pennington in R4 at UFC 307; 1.53 knockdowns per 100 head strikes absorbed vs a division rate of 0.33
almost never kicks: 0.5% of her time-decayed significant attempts go to the legs (division 9.3%)
long layoffs: Jan 2017 to Jul 2019, Jul 2022 to Oct 2024, and none since Jun 2025
style.summary: A wrestle-boxer who wins with toughness rather than polish. On the feet she throws almost nothing but punches to the head and is happy to trade; in the clinch and on top she looks for the back and the rear-naked choke, which beat Nunes. Her takedown defence is poor, she has been dropped four times, and grapplers and strong wrestlers have submitted her three times.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body moves to 1, leg moves to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 92.9% head, 6.6% body, 0.5% legs (landed 85.6/13.4/1.0); career attempts 87.7/10.6/1.7; women's bantamweight league 75.9/14.8/9.3. So the director should send her almost everything to the head, and the leg group barely matters (split evenly because nothing separates calf from inside kicks). No published technique breakdown was found (re-checked Nov 6, 2026), so the split inside each group is a judgment from the dataset: a punch-only boxer mix with hooks and straights, head kick near zero, body punches over body kicks because her body strikes come mostly in the clinch and on the ground (vs Shevchenko 22 of 27 body with 25 of 30 in the clinch; vs McMann 11 of 11 body with 10 of 10 in the clinch). knee 0.10 reflects that clinch body work (ufcstats does not record technique); elbow 0.05 reflects the Dudieva finish (elbows from mount). Low confidence.

engine_notes.note: Chin: 4 knockdowns absorbed in 12 UFC fights, 1.53 per 100 head strikes absorbed career (division 0.33), but no KO/TKO loss; she was dropped three times by Nunes and still went the distance.
No knockdowns scored in 12 UFC fights. Both KO/TKO wins came from mount (punches 2013, elbows 2015), so stand-up power should sit below the division mean.

Grappling exchange is lopsided: she lands 1.7 takedowns per 15 min at 55% career (division 1.24 at 40%) but concedes 2.1 per 15 at 76%. Time-decayed control is 141 s per 15 for her and 270 s against her.

Pace in 5-round fights (landed per minute vs round 1): 1.00, 1.64, 0.78, 0.65, 1.01; division 1.00, 1.26, 0.95, 1.22, 1.11. Rounds 3-5 rest on two fights (Nunes II, Pennington), so treat as weak evidence.

Inactivity: 17 months since her last MMA fight at the as-of date, after earlier layoffs of about 30 and 26 months, with elbow surgery (Jul 2025) and back surgery (by Sep 2025) in between. Her next competition is a wrestling match (Nov 14, 2026), not MMA. Time-decayed sums carry only 31 minutes.
